item.title: The whole footpath is covered, 12th August
item.description:
This public footpath/alleyway has become severely overgrown on both sides, with dense vegetation and bushes encroaching so far that they have almost completely blocked the path. The growth restricts the usable width to a narrow strip, making it very difficult and unsafe to pass through, especially for anyone with pushchairs, mobility aids, or when passing others. This path is a recognised public right of way and needs the vegetation cut back to the fence lines on both sides to restore safe, clear access for all users. A photo showing the full extent of the obstruction is attached.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Innsworth Lane, Innsworth, Tewkesbury
Report on FixMyStreet
